text: ah ha. that is it. the ] button has brought this into view. I have literally never seen this before lol.
resolution: Recorded the user's visual confirmation that pressing ] on the world surface changes the floor and reveals Section D's conditional Map command group, including the previously unseen Trigger/Spawn controls. This promotes the finding from statically reachable/unverified to observed conditional UI. It also establishes a separate UX defect: Section D silently changes command families based on prior command/menu state, with no visible mode selector or explanation, so an unrelated floor-cycle hotkey exposes a toolbar the user had never discovered. No code changed.
